y-m-80-09.goal: Hlola ngemizekelo ukuba zeziphi iintlobo zeempazamo zokungenisa idijithi yokuhlola ebamba ngokuqinisekileyo nezo ezinokuzishiya, uze ucacise umda wayo ngokwenza ngokwakho imeko ayishiyayo.
y-m-80-09.material:
I-International Standard Book Number (ISBN-13) kwikhava yangasemva yencwadi inamanani ali-13. Phindaphinda amanani okuqala ali-12 ngolandelelwano nge-1, 3, 1, 3, ... uze uwadibanise onke ukufumana u-S, kwaye inani lesi-13 (idijithi yokuhlola) linani elisuka ku-0 ukuya ku-9 elenza isixa sonke sibe sisiphindaphindi se-10 xa songezwa ku-S.
Umzekelo (inani eliyilwayo): ukuba amanani okuqala ali-12 ngu-9 7 8 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9, ngoko S = 9×1+7×3+8×1+1×3+2×1+3×3+4×1+5×3+6×1+7×3+8×1+9×3 = 133, kwaye idijithi yokuhlola ngu-7 (133+7=140).
